resources.string: Stream independent music in FLAC. Enter a Jamendo developer client ID. The API is free for noncommercial use.
Stream FLAC from your own library using an HTTPS OpenSubsonic server. Use the account provided by your server administrator. The server software is free.
Open a public live recording that offers FLAC. These recordings are free and require no account.
Your Bandcamp account is free. Artists set the prices. Download the FLAC from your purchase page, extract the ZIP if needed, then choose the FLAC files to play in Astral.
Full-track streaming requires a commercial agreement with MassiveMusic and the licensors. This source requires a licensed Astral integration before it can play music.
